name: Lentil, Potato, and Tomato Curry
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 large potatoes, cut into ½ inch cubes

steps: In a large pot, combine and cook water, lentils, salt and bay leaf.
In a large frying pan, combine potatoes, turmeric, cayenne pepper, olive oil and margarine. Fry for 5–10 minutes.
Add potato mixture to the pot with the lentils along with all remaining ingredients. Cook until the potatoes are soft and tender.

culture.text: This creates a healthy, inexpensive and easy stew with depths of flavor. This recipe is fairly low on the heat scale, but feel free to add more cayenne pepper to up its spiciness. It is excellent served with chapatis or rice.
